note: Issue 394, commanders.md section 8. The after-battle report: his company fought this month and is still in being. Unskippable for the same reason as at_the_front: a battle is not a grievance. The figure is the men he has now, never the men he lost, which the payload knows and this letter does not claim. Placeholder prose.

body.text: We have fought near {param:near}. I have {param:men} men standing, and I will not pretend to you that it went as I would have liked or that it did not.
Tell me what the Crown wants of the men I have left.

options.text: and am glad you are still in the field
and a great deal rests on what you do next

steps.prompt: What the Crown would have him do

options.label: press on
options.text: Press on while they are still reeling.

options.label: hold and recover
options.text: Hold where you are and let the men recover.

options.label: fall back
options.text: Fall back to the town that feeds you. You have done enough for one season.
